chapters.title: Contamination
chapters.blurb: A model that memorized its homework scores perfectly on leaked questions and fails fresh ones — the fingerprint of contamination.

chapters.title: Goodhart's Law
chapters.blurb: Four hundred real gradient steps on a flawed benchmark: the proxy hits its all-time high as true quality collapses.

chapters.title: Calibration
chapters.blurb: When a model says ninety nine percent, is it right ninety nine percent of the time? A really-trained classifier says no — until temperature scaling.

chapters.title: Variance and Significance
chapters.blurb: Two thousand reruns of a hundred-question benchmark: the genuinely better model loses almost half of them.

chapters.title: The Expensive Claim
chapters.blurb: The closing thesis: the metric went up is an expensive claim, and honest evaluation is the gauntlet that attacks it.
